## Accessibility

<!-- Components only. Delete this section for anything else. -->

- [ ] axe passes on every variant and state
- [ ] Keyboard matrix in the spec, and it matches reality
- [ ] Screen-reader pass documented
- [ ] States readable without relying on colour

## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally
- [ ] Changeset added, or a line here saying why none is needed
- [ ] New dependencies justified: why this one, what it weighs, what it pulls in,
      and whether it ships to consumers or stays in the build
